cohort: 99 pregnancies of 34 women with Glucokinase-Maturity onset diabetes of the young (GCK-MODY)
finding: Offspring of mothers with GCK-MODY who were unaffected by the mutation had significantly higher birthweight, LGA rates, and CS rates compared to affected offspring.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight: 4.0 +/- 0.7 kg (unaffected offspring), 3.4 +/- 0.4 kg (affected offspring)
